description: This file contains the implementation of the tlKeyword class, which supports management of keywords within the TestLink project. It includes methods for serialization/deserialization to/from XML, CSV, database interactions (create, read, update, delete), and validation of keyword data.

classes.name: tlKeyword
classes.description: A class that manages keywords associated with test projects, supporting database operations, data serialization to XML and CSV formats, and validation.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the keyword object with provided database ID, test project ID, name, and notes.

methods.name: readFromDB
methods.description: Reads a keyword's data from the database given a database connection and options.

methods.name: writeToDB
methods.description: Creates or updates a keyword record in the database.

methods.name: deleteFromDB
methods.description: Deletes the keyword and related associations from the database.

methods.name: getByID
methods.description: Retrieves a single keyword object by its database ID.

methods.name: getByIDs
methods.description: Retrieves multiple keyword objects by their database IDs.

methods.name: checkKeywordName
methods.description: Validates the syntax of a keyword name.
